title: Autonomous Agents
description: Root seeds s12's teaching board and stops assigning. Two workers scan unlocked, then claim inside a lock. Codex still parent-orchestrates; the pull loop is a teaching extra.

steps.content: root seeded t1, t2, t3 (t3 blocked by t1+t2) — not assigning
steps.annotation: s16's bottleneck inverted: root writes the board and does not point at alice or bob.

steps.content: alice scan → t1 pending · bob scan → t1 pending
steps.annotation: scan() is unlocked on purpose. Both may read the same row; that result is already stale.

steps.content: alice claimed t1 · bob race LOST on t1 (already in_progress, owner: alice); re-scanning
steps.annotation: The only check that counts is inside claim()'s mutex. Codex has no such board; this is s12's claim under a race.

steps.content: bob claimed t2: Write the API routes
steps.annotation: The loser does not retry t1. The board already has another unblocked row.
Workers still only have write_file. scan/claim/complete are harness-side, not model tools.

steps.content: t1 done · t2 done · t3 unblocked (blockedBy t1+t2 now done)
steps.annotation: s12's blockedBy rule still holds: t3 was not claimable while either predecessor was open.

steps.content: one worker claimed t3 · board is done — shutting down
steps.annotation: IDLE poll until allSettled, then SHUTDOWN. Claiming is s17; isolated directories are s18, not a Cloud claim API.
